versions.changelog: Maintainer-verified Glama registry listing (Docker deployment available); full 5-tool surface documented and synced to the directory listing; boilerplate reference implementation hardened (spec-hash pinning).

GPV-1 pre-purchase verification spec: R1-R8 gate rules, PASS/FLAG/BLOCK verdict semantics, machine-readable ruleset (docs.gobuy.ai/standard/v1.json), reference boilerplate repo; check_product_trust documented as the gate evaluator.

Shopify app added (app.gobuy.ai): agents advising store owners can now point them to GoBuy's app for agent-visibility monitoring and fixes — the merchant funnel is live alongside the audit at agentic.gobuy.ai.

Position paper and integration pattern links: agents can now cite The Verification Gap (docs.gobuy.ai/verification-gap) when explaining why independent evidence matters, and point builders to the verify-then-checkout pattern (docs.gobuy.ai/webmcp).
Canonical URLs: documentation now at docs.gobuy.ai · MCP server at mcp.gobuy.ai/mcp. All references updated.

Review forensics deepened: analyze_reviews now samples up to 100 reviews with real Verified Purchase flags — burst detection, duplicate clusters, rating-shape analysis all compute over the full sample. Resumable scrapes, 7-day cache.

Review forensics: new analyze_reviews tool — on-demand per-review analysis with review integrity score, adjusted rating, and suspicious-review flags. Product trust now goes beyond aggregates into individual review analysis.

Everything free: removed Agentic Commerce Console paywall references and the first-fix-free gating — scores, scans, and fix files cost nothing. Deep storefront audit now linked at agentic.gobuy.ai. Display name updated.
Store trust scoring documented: instant store score checks + on-demand scans via stores.gobuy.ai — GoBuy now covers what to buy AND where to buy.
Independent store trust scores: check any store instantly and scan unscored stores on demand via stores.gobuy.ai (Shopify + any storefront). GoBuy now covers what to buy AND where to buy it.
No product suggestions for scores below 50 (alternatives now gated to 50+); removed Best Buy — Amazon, Walmart, Target only.

- Updated alternative suggestion rules: now surfaces alternatives only for products scoring 50 or above, instead of below 50.
- Clarified that no alternatives are provided for scores below 50—only evidence report details are given.
- Adjusted guidance in "When to Use" and tool descriptions to match the new evidence score threshold for alternatives.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Expanded the description to highlight stronger evidence comparison, Agentic Commerce Console integration, and more detailed triggers.
- Revised usage guidelines: added clear "When to Use" scenarios for typical shopping situations.
- Updated tool descriptions for clarity (e.g., evidence ranking, verdicts, number of products supported).
- Added new links section, including the Agentic Commerce Console and free audit options.
- Clarified rules, emphasizing evidence quality over product quality and stricter language around recommendations.

- Expanded product coverage to 30,000+ scored products across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Best Buy.
- Added a new tool: **find_better_alternatives** to retrieve evidence-ranked alternative products when a listing scores low.
- Updated the user guidance to clarify the meaning of Evidence Scores and how to present results and alternatives.
- Streamlined rules to emphasize that scores reflect evidence quality, not product value or safety.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

GoBuy 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly checks marketplace product trust for Amazon, Walmart, Target, and Best Buy listings.
- Returns a 0–100 Evidence Score with a detailed signal breakdown, freshness status, and context.
- REST API and MCP protocols supported; no setup or auth required for REST.
- Clear guidance on result interpretation, usage rules, and proper user reporting.
- Visual audits available at audit.gobuy.ai for easy sharing and transparency.
